machan.title: How to build the machan (trellis)
machan.what: A machan is a frame over the bed. Climbers like gourds and peas grow up it, leaving the ground below free for other crops.
machan.alt: Drawing of a machan: two posts, a top frame and crisscross rope
machan.confirm: Post spacing and rope pattern are not in the sources: ask a local builder or your KVK, and adjust to your wind and soil.
option.title: Choose your plan
option.hint: The same land planned five ways. Compare what each gives and asks of you, then pick one.
option.numbers: {{beds}} beds · {{crops}} crops · about {{kg}} kg a year (estimate)
option.income.name: Most income
option.income.what: Most land to vegetable beds and the highest-value crops first. More harvest, more work and water.
option.balanced.name: Balanced
option.balanced.what: A mix of income and food for the family, with trees, a pond and a rotation field.
option.low_work.name: Low work, low risk
option.low_work.what: More trees and fewer beds: less to sow, weed and pick each week. Suits an owner who visits rarely.
option.family_food.name: Family food and soil
option.family_food.what: The widest mix of crops and a bigger rotation field to build the soil.
option.water_saver.name: Water saver
option.water_saver.what: A bigger pond and crops that need less water first. For borewell or rain-only farms.

editor.hint: Move land between uses (in steps of 5% of the plot, up to 10% each) and pick a bed size. The engine redraws beds and crops.

goal.goal.income_what: More land to high-value crops; more work and water.
goal.goal.low_work_what: Trees and easy crops; fewer weekly tasks.
goal.goal.home_food: Food for my family, healthy soil
goal.goal.home_food_what: Many different crops and soil building.
goal.goal.both_what: Some income and some food for the family.
goal.method.multilayer_what: Four crops stacked in one bed, climbers on a machan.
goal.method.flowers_what: Marigold and other flowers for sale and to protect crops.
goal.method.natural_what: No chemicals; jeevamrut and compost made on the farm.
goal.method.polyhouse_what: Covered growing for high-value crops (costly to build).
goal.method.integrated_what: Cows, poultry or fish with crops, waste back as manure.
